purpose: Only determine A/B evidence availability, source compatibility declarations and the specific old-media evidence gap. No installation or deployment readiness claim.

timing.freshSnapshotStartsAt: Actual first remote read, not preparation or a later successful continuation.
timing.effectiveDeadline: Earlier of actual start plus 1800 seconds and approval time plus 18000 seconds. Stop if insufficient time remains.
timing.evidenceValidity: Each artifact expiry, scanner DB 48-hour age and original evidence deadline remains independent; earliest applicable bound controls. No workload lease or resource TTL is opened.

authentication.aws: Existing fixed Source profile, official ca-central-1 STS/ECR endpoints, no profile/config changes or AssumeRole.
authentication.github: Existing Git credential helper once, after exact STS identity succeeds; credential held only in memory and sent only to api.github.com.

remoteReadOperations.accept: Exact account and IAM user ARN only; failure or another identity stops before Git authentication.

remoteReadOperations.selection: Only returned first page. Filter exact repository/head_repository ID, completed/success, main, workflow path, original attempt 1, event push or workflow_dispatch. Order by created_at descending then numeric run ID descending; select at most two runs with distinct source commits. No second page or fallback to historical A0/expired run. This is a bounded sample, not proof no other versions exist.

remoteReadOperations.binding: At most once per selected run. Require unique checked-app-{selectedCommit}-{selectedRunId}-1, exact workflow_run/repository/source, nonexpired and positive size at most 500 MiB, authenticated ZIP digest. Incomplete artifact page stops; absent or expired app records a build-needed gap, not permission to rebuild.

At most these six files for each selected commit. Verify exact path/ref and blob bytes/SHA; no branch-head fetch, recursive tree, extra imported files, code execution or dependency installation. Per decoded file at most 1 MiB. Missing file is a compatibility evidence gap; no expanded search. Inspect only build/startup/DB-profile/schema/API/storage declarations, not business records. Unexpected credential literals stop without persisting source bodies.

remoteReadOperations.condition: Only if at least one eligible app artifact exists; exact repository and strict IMMUTABLE required. No account-wide image listing or scan request.

remoteReadOperations.imageIds: One exact app-sha{selectedCommit}-r{selectedRunId}-a1 tag per eligible app. Missing/unpublished is retained as candidate-only; never push or search another tag. Hash original manifest bytes against returned imageDigest.

Only if a root index contains exactly one linux/amd64 descriptor: its exact returned digest, once per root. Single-platform root needs no extra call. Verify raw bytes/config digest with existing registry verifier; no descendant scan.

remoteReadOperations.condition: Only eligible authenticated API artifact metadata within the selected runs; at most one original app ZIP each, no lifecycle ZIP. Reuse existing fixed-four-file parser/build/scan verifier. Compare existing historical Node/scanner profile; a profile difference remains PROFILE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, not automatic policy change. No product binding or catalog write.

downloadHandling.redirectPolicy: Use the existing catalogSourceReaders official blob-host allowlist. Only the original API 302 and one official blob GET; never forward GitHub Authorization to the blob host, save signed URLs or follow extra redirects.
downloadHandling.destination: A fresh create-only private child of E:/NodejsProject/TechlongSoftware/.local-secrets; never commit ZIP, extracted originals or provider source bodies.
downloadHandling.originals: Preserve earlier originals/stops; no overwrite, fence reset, deletion or automatic retry. Reuse validators, not two collect invocations that repeat STS/runs/repository reads. This review is not a CatalogSourceScope CLI input and adds no reader implementation.

inspect: Authoritative schema and client API version declarations
Existing persistent image provider and URL semantics
compatibilityAcceptance.rule: Source observations plus old initialization receipt are preparation evidence, not current DB state or an approved compatibility policy. Unseen startup imports, missing schema/API versions or unsupported Full remain unproven; do not substitute fixture values or infer compatibility from a smoke pass.

futureFixedPrivateReceiptRead.projection: Only target identity, media row count/provider/URL classification and file-copy/migration evidence references or booleans. Whole bounded JSON may enter memory; do not retain customer/order/payment rows or follow referenced files/URLs. Missing file/hash mismatch stops this read, no alternate path search.

persistenceRead.knownGap: Historical test-data import copied nine local-media records but not their files. Bucket/IAM/idle task wiring already accepted; do not query them again merely to re-prove installation.
notAuthorized: image bytes or arbitrary URL fetch
persistenceRead.resultLimit: Can classify the exact historical media-evidence gap only. No full current reference inventory, byte mapping or end-to-end persistence proof; keep persistentUploadsReady=false and verificationSha256=null. Any later media/tenant read needs its exact source/key/query scope separately approved.

failureAndOutput.unexpectedErrors: Stop on authentication, identity, integrity, incomplete selected-run artifact page, attempted extra page, unexpected scope or transport failure. The deliberately bounded ten-run sample may have a next link but it is never followed. No diagnostic request, retry, alternative credential/profile or extra read from unused budget.
failureAndOutput.expectedGaps: No eligible run/artifact, unpublished tag, insufficient distinct digests or missing declaration is recorded as a gap; only remaining independent allowlisted evidence may be collected, never substitute data or build automatically.
failureAndOutput.privateOutput: Fresh create-only records with actual times, exact selected IDs/commits, original provenance, digests, counts, source declarations and gap list. Preserve failures. Only sanitized summary/hashes may later be committed.
failureAndOutput.publicStatus: READ_ONLY_EVIDENCE_COLLECTED_WITH_EXPLICIT_GAPS or STOPPED; not RELEASE_READY, not persistence acceptance and not authorization to register a release/seed, enable runtime or deploy.

risks: Existing AWS/Git credentials may be broader than these reads; credentials are used only in memory and sent only to fixed official services, but provider/network/audit logs remain possible.

Up to two original app ZIPs and source/metadata enter private memory/disk; media receipt may contain business fields before projection. Do not print credentials, signed URLs, business bodies or private source originals.
Version/root/platform/config digests and historical/current evidence are distinct. No single snapshot is cross-service atomic; selected first-page sample may not find all available versions.
Network, API, artifact transfer/storage and ordinary provider access logs can have low nonzero cost; no resource restoration or ongoing environment window is started.

Failure stops without compensation, cleanup, replay or auto-renewal. Missing persistence or schema evidence remains missing; this read cannot guarantee that later build/restore/update will be possible.
